summary: The Fractal web sidebar gains a Show menu beside agent search: check Waiting for answer to see agents with an open st question or attention item, and check machines to see agents on any of them. Each choice shows a count, writes the matching is:asking or machine: search token, and typed tokens update the menu. The machine choice is remembered in this browser; the Needs me toggle and Host select are replaced by the menu.
